'''Ian Rajala''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Fort Collins tournament]] on 20 October 2001 with Observation Camera deck (Combat Response start), according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3074">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-24-ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizzd3074/ ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizz], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 24 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-24-ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizzd3074/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
